name: IRON
aliases: IRON — Inverse Rendering by Optimizing Neural SDFs and Materials
Inverse Rendering by Optimizing Neural SDFs and Materials
Photometric Inverse Rendering with Shading Cues Modeling and Surface Reflectance Regularization
definition: A neural inverse rendering pipeline that operates on photometric images (captured with a collocated flashlight and moving camera) to output high-quality 3D content in the format of triangle meshes and material textures. It uses neural representations for geometry (SDFs) and materials during optimization.
summary: IRON reconstructs 3D geometry and materials from photometric images using neural SDFs and a two-stage optimization, unlike standard NeRFs that optimize density and color directly.
